surface.description: Where the event came from. Sent on every event, $pageview included. The local web app, desktop and the server never send events (ADR-024, ADR-090).

app_version.description: The x.y.z version of the build that sent the event: the web build's version on the landing page and the portal, the app version on the phone. Sent on every event.

locale.description: The interface language when the event was sent. Sent on every event.

$pageview.description: A landing page was viewed. Sent by posthog-js in cookieless mode with the shared properties and PostHog's own URL, UTM and referrer properties; a referrer from the local app (/app) is dropped (ADR-090). No other properties.

landing_cta_clicked.description: A call to action on the landing page was clicked.

app_first_opened.description: Sent once per install, right after the first opt-in (which may come later, from Settings). Nothing is sent before a person opts in, so earlier opens are never counted.

portal_opened.description: The hosted portal was opened by a signed-in person who has turned on anonymous usage.

analytics_opted_in.description: A person turned on anonymous usage. A new random ID is created first, so this is the first event under it.

prompt.description: Turned on from the one-time prompt or from Settings.

analytics_opted_out.description: A person turned anonymous usage off. The last event under the random ID: captured, flushed with anything already queued, then sending stops and the ID is reset (MUT-153 D5). Signing out resets without sending it.

client_created.description: A client was created on the phone. Clients are created online only, so this fires when the server confirms the create, never on a failed attempt. The portal does not create clients.

income_recorded.description: An income entry was saved. Phone: on the local save, so offline entries count when they are made. Portal: when the server confirms the save (personal profile only, MUT-133).

currency.description: The entry's currency code. Never the amount.

paid.description: Whether it was saved as already paid.

expense_recorded.description: An expense was saved. Phone: on the local save. Portal: when the server confirms the save.

currency.description: The expense's currency code. Never the amount.

payment_recorded.description: A payment received was saved. Phone: on the local save. Portal: when the server confirms Record payment.

currency.description: The payment's currency code. Never the amount.
